hunks.sol: Unlike the dejected Hyuk Mujin, Han Yeop sounded calm.

hunks.baseline: “Hey, punk. Doesn’t it bother you at all?”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin found himself at a loss for words. Right. Maybe it didn’t have to bother him.

hunks.baseline: “I know what the deputy squad leader is thinking. I know what you want to say.”

hunks.baseline: “When I first came to, a lot of things went through my mind. The relief of being alive. The helplessness I felt that day. The despair over my own martial arts.”

hunks.baseline: One question had been circling through his head ever since that day.
hunks.sol: One question had been circling through his mind ever since that day.

hunks.baseline: *Can I reach that realm?*
hunks.sol: *Can I ever reach that realm?*

hunks.sol: Even “overwhelming” didn’t begin to describe it. All his hard work, all the pride he had taken in his martial arts, had been ripped up by the roots.

hunks.baseline: “I admitted that I’m weak. It wasn’t even that hard. I’ve always known. But…”
hunks.sol: “I accepted that I’m weak. It wasn’t even that hard. I’ve always known it. But…”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll get stronger. As strong as Jopil. No—far stronger than Jopil.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll get stronger. As strong as Jopil. No—much stronger.”

hunks.baseline: Han Yeop went on, his voice firm.
hunks.sol: Han Yeop continued, his voice firm.

hunks.baseline: “Thinking about that made me happy. If I become a Peak master, I can get that strong too. Something like that.”
hunks.sol: “Once I started thinking that way, I felt happy. If I become a Peak master, I can be that strong too. That sort of thing.”

hunks.baseline: The Peak realm was a domain granted to only a rare few. Coming from Han Yeop, who was barely second- or third-rate, the declaration was almost laughable.
hunks.sol: The Peak realm was open to only a rare few. Coming from Han Yeop, who was barely second- or third-rate, the declaration was almost laughable.

hunks.baseline: *You’ve changed. You too.*
hunks.sol: *You’ve changed too.*

hunks.baseline: So much had changed. The situation. The people.
hunks.sol: So much had changed. Their circumstances. The people around him.

hunks.baseline: Even the timid second-rate martial artist had, before anyone noticed, stepped into that current. Hyuk Mujin felt his heart lurch. The next words burst out before he could stop them.
hunks.sol: Even that timid second-rate martial artist had been swept up in the current before anyone noticed. Hyuk Mujin felt his heart swell, and the next words burst out before he could stop them.

hunks.baseline: Han Yeop’s eyes went round, then he flashed a grin.

They both thought of the same man.
Jin Taekyung.

hunks.baseline: They thought of the same person at the same time. Jin Taekyung. He was already running far ahead of them. What was he doing now?
hunks.sol: He was already running far ahead of them. What was he doing now?

hunks.baseline: *Still, I have to admit it’s kind of admirable.*
hunks.sol: *Still, I have to admit it was kind of admirable.*

hunks.sol: *Could this be the last time I see them?*

hunks.sol: I was close to meeting the final condition of the Logout Quest: 500 Fame. Today’s visit to Medicine King Hall was a farewell of sorts.

hunks.sol: *Well, there’s no need to tell them. Seeing their faces is enough.*

hunks.sol: I’d already looked in on the other reconnaissance squad members. Now that I’d seen Han Yeop and Hyuk Mujin too, there was only one more place to visit…

hunks.baseline: “It’s the mind-reading uncle!”
hunks.sol: “It’s the mind-reading mister!”

hunks.sol: The moment I entered the room, they both reacted. I stopped the still-pale Gong Yacheong from rising, then hauled Socheon back to his feet after he dropped into a full bow.

hunks.sol: “Stay lying down. And you, get up, punk. Am I old enough to have you bowing to me?”

hunks.baseline: “I’ve received a kindness a hundred bows couldn’t repay.”
hunks.sol: “You have shown me a kindness a hundred bows could never repay.”

hunks.sol: Tears were already welling in both their eyes. Soyul, who didn’t understand what was happening, hugged her rag doll tight and scampered over to cling to her brother.

hunks.baseline: “Big brother, did you put on the Benefactor’s kindness? Show me too. Is it pretty?”
hunks.sol: “Big Brother, did you get a kindness? Let me see it too. Is it pretty?”

hunks.sol: What had I seen in those young siblings who had lost their parents? Who had Gong Yacheong and the reconnaissance squad reminded me of…?

hunks.sol: “Ah, I heard the news as well. Is that what troubles you?”

hunks.sol: “They say there will soon be a major battle.”

hunks.sol: As the saying went, words without feet could travel a thousand li. Ever since I’d taken Jopil down, my name seemed to have started spreading in earnest.

hunks.sol: I opened the Quest Window for a quick look. I had only about fifty Fame left to go.

hunks.baseline: Logout was as good as decided.
hunks.sol: Logout was practically a foregone conclusion.

hunks.baseline: Of course they had no way of knowing my situation. I listened quietly to Gong Yacheong and Socheon, then rose from my seat.
hunks.sol: Of course, neither of them had any way of knowing my situation. I listened quietly to Gong Yacheong and Socheon for a while, then rose from my seat.

hunks.baseline: “I think I should be going.”
hunks.sol: “I should get going.”

hunks.baseline: Gong Yacheong was the one who stopped Socheon when the boy looked disappointed.

hunks.baseline: “That’s enough.”
hunks.sol: “That is enough.”

hunks.sol: Socheon lowered his head glumly. Soyul, who had been playing alone with her doll, looked up at me with huge eyes.

hunks.sol: “Young Master Jin. Even if you must leave, should you not take what you left behind?”

hunks.baseline: “The thing I left behind?”
hunks.sol: “What I left behind?”

hunks.sol: I thought about it for a moment, but there was no way I’d forgotten anything. Thanks to the cheat feature known as Inventory, I always traveled light.

hunks.baseline: “There’s nothing like tha—what is this?”
hunks.sol: “I didn’t leave anyth—what is this?”

hunks.sol: Still bewildered, I accepted the bundle. It was surprisingly heavy. Just as I was about to see what was inside, Gong Yacheong spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Unwrap it in your quarters. Don’t let anyone else see.”
hunks.sol: “Unwrap it in your quarters. Do not let anyone else see.”

hunks.sol: I unwrapped the bundle as soon as I reached my quarters. Then I understood what Gong Yacheong’s final warning had meant.

hunks.baseline: *These really are the kind of things people would covet if they saw them.*
hunks.sol: *These really are the sort of things people would covet if they saw them.*
